metadata.title: Luxe Spa Portraiture with Bold Overlaid Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, layered group portrait of four individuals wearing white terry-cloth bathrobes and dark sunglasses, characterized by a warm, grainy film aesthetic and a massive, flat yellow typographic overlay across the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of white robe textures against warm skin tones
Contrast between dark, opaque eyewear and bright yellow lettering
Staggered depth of field creating a sense of intimacy and exclusivity
Juxtaposition of casual spa attire with high-fashion stoicism
coreInvariants: Flat, vibrant yellow color for typography
Consistent use of dark, varied-style sunglasses on all subjects
White textured bathrobes as the primary wardrobe

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are arranged in a diagonal recession from right to left, filling the frame from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The male figure on the right acts as the primary anchor, being the largest and most forward in the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large figure on the right, across the faces of the three women, and down to the bold yellow text at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with subjects and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm neutrals and whites from robes and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks from the sunglasses and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant sunflower yellow for the graphic text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text contrasting with the muted, naturalistic palette of the photograph.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard geometric proportions

anatomy.counters: Open but small due to weight

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric purity and heavy weight.
Provides the necessary modern, blocky presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, film-style photograph of four diverse people in a spa setting. They are wearing white terry-cloth bathrobes and dark sunglasses. The lighting is warm and natural, coming from the side. The composition is a tight group shot from the chest up.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place four large, uppercase, geometric sans-serif letters across the bottom of the image in a bright sunflower yellow. The letters should be spaced evenly to span the entire width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the yellow text perfectly flat and opaque?
Does the text span the full width of the composition?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the sunglasses or robes

mustAchieve: Tactile texture of the white robes
High-contrast graphic impact of the text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grain doesn't look like digital noise.
Check that the yellow text is legible against the white robes.
Verify the depth of field keeps all faces relatively clear.
Confirm the 'cool' and 'stoic' mood is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered group portrait in white robes + dark sunglasses + film grain texture + bold geometric yellow display type at the base.
